SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefXLOBDeleteDownload
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID,FG.NAME,S.SITE_KEY,S.SITE_DESCRIPTION,S.SITE_TYPE,XA.ID,FG.TYPE, SUM(NVL(XIA.ALLOCATION, 0)) from FUNCTIONAL_GROUP FG CROSS JOIN SITE S LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY beSite INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE beTypeSite ON beTypeSite.business_entity_type_key = beSite.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY on S.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY = beSite.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY LEFT JOIN ITEM_FG_MAP IFM INNER JOIN ITEM_MASTER IM INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY BE INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE BET ON BET.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY = BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY ON BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY = IM.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY ON IFM.ITEM_KEY = IM.ITEM_KEY ON IFM.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID = FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN XLOB_ALLOCATION XA INNER JOIN XLOB_ITEM_ALLOCATION XIA ON XIA.XLOB_ALLOCATION_ID = XA.ID ON XA.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID = FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID AND XA.SITE_KEY = S.SITE_KEY
SearchFormDefinition.ExtractSource: select FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID,FG.NAME,S.SITE_KEY,S.SITE_DESCRIPTION,S.SITE_TYPE,XA.ID,FG.TYPE from FUNCTIONAL_GROUP FG CROSS JOIN SITE S LEFT JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY beSite INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE beTypeSite ON beTypeSite.business_entity_type_key = beSite.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY on S.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY = beSite.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY LEFT JOIN ITEM_FG_MAP IFM INNER JOIN ITEM_MASTER IM INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY BE INNER JOIN BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE BET ON BET.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY = BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_TYPE_KEY ON BE.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY = IM.BUSINESS_ENTITY_KEY ON IFM.ITEM_KEY = IM.ITEM_KEY ON IFM.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID = FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN XLOB_ALLOCATION XA INNER JOIN XLOB_ITEM_ALLOCATION XIA ON XIA.XLOB_ALLOCATION_ID = XA.ID ON XA.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID = FG.FUNCTIONAL_GROUP_ID AND XA.SITE_KEY = S.SITE_KEY

ListValue.label: info.yes
ListValue.value: not null AND XIA.END_DATE >= add_months(current_date,-12) AND NVL(XIA.ALLOCATION, 0) > 0

ListValue.label: info.no
ListValue.value: null or exists (select 1 from XLOB_ITEM_ALLOCATION xia_1 where xia_1.XLOB_ALLOCATION_ID = XIA.XLOB_ALLOCATION_ID and xia_1.END_DATE >= add_months(current_date,-12) having sum(NVL(xia_1.ALLOCATION, 0)) = 0)
